rows.answer:

rows.question: Where do I report an absence?
rows.answer:
To report a student absence at Vista Ridge High School, you have two main options:

- **Email:** Send an absence note or medical documentation from the parent/guardian's email address that is on file to **VRHSattendance@leanderisd.org**.
- **In Person:** Hand deliver the absence note or documentation to the Attendance Office.

Notes should include the student's full legal name, ID number, grade, and the reason for the absence. Please submit absence notes within two days after the student returns to school. Notes are accepted in English and Spanish.

If you need more details, you can also visit the [Absence for students](https://www.leanderisd.org/attendance) page.

Let me know if you need help with anything else!

rows.question: What is the student check-out policy?
rows.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

- **Parent/Guardian Presence Required:** To check a student out early, a parent or guardian must come to the office in person, provide a photo ID, and check the student out.  
- **No Phone Calls:** Phone calls for early dismissal are NOT accepted for student safety.
- **Advance Arrival:** Due to high volume, parents/guardians should arrive at least 20 minutes before the desired release time.
- **No Early Check-Outs After 2:45 PM:** In-person early check-outs are not allowed after 2:45 PM. After this time, students must wait for regular dismissal.
- **Student Sign-In/Out:** Students MUST sign in and out at the Attendance Window when leaving or returning to campus.
- **Documentation Required:** After the absence, a follow-up note or email documenting the reason for the absence is required to excuse it. The note/email should include the student’s full legal name, ID number, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal.
- **Email Option:** Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used to check students out at any time later in the day.

For full details, you can visit: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out)

If you have further questions, you can contact the Attendance Office. Let me know if you need their email address or any more help!
sources: How To Check Your Student Out Early

rows.question: How do I appeal an attendance decision?
rows.answer:
To appeal an attendance decision at Vista Ridge High School, you need to follow the process for an attendance hours appeal. Here’s what the context says:

- Appeals are only considered for extenuating circumstances (such as medical procedures or emergencies).
- You must provide supporting documentation for your situation; without it, the appeal will be denied.
- The school has an Attendance Appeal Request Form that you will need to complete. This form asks for details about your hours owed, any hours you have already made up, and your reasons for appealing.
- Completed forms and documentation should be submitted to your Assistant Principal.

**Steps to start your appeal:**
1. Contact your Assistant Principal to discuss your situation and request the Attendance Appeal Request Form.
2. Fill out the form, attach any supporting documentation, and submit it as directed by your Assistant Principal.

If you have questions or need the form, you can reach out to your Assistant Principal. You can find their contact information on the [Assistant Principals’ Office page](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-assistant-principals-offi/home).

Let me know if you need help finding your specific Assistant Principal’s contact! Good luck with your appeal.

rows.question: How do I register for AP tests?
rows.answer:
Here’s how to register for AP tests at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

**1. Register with College Board**
- Create or log in to your College Board account at [myap.collegeboard.org](https://myap.collegeboard.org/login).
- Enroll in each of your AP classes using the JOIN CODE provided by your teacher.
- Indicate whether you plan to take the AP exam (“YES” or “NO”) for each class. The default is “YES,” so change it before the October 28, 2026 deadline if you do NOT want to take the exam.
- Even if you don’t plan to take the exam, you still need to register with MyAP.

**2. Register and Pay with Total Registration**
- Go to the [Total Registration Link](https://user.totalregistration.net/AP/441176).
- Create an account or log in if you already have one.
- Pay for your exams online. The cost is $85 per exam, or $27 per exam if you qualify for free/reduced lunch.
- Complete registration and payment by October 28, 2026 to avoid a $40 late fee per exam. Late registration is available from October 28, 2026 to February 18, 2027.

**3. Special Notes**
- If you need accommodations, requests and documentation must be submitted through SSD Online by January 22, 2027.
- For second semester AP Government & Macroeconomics, registration is open January 5 – February 18, 2027.
- If you need help or want to cancel an exam, contact the campus Dean of Instruction, Olga Angelo-Day, at olga.angelo-day@leanderisd.org.

For more details, visit the [AP Test Registration Info](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/ap-test-registration) page or the [VR Advanced Placement Website](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/advanced-placement/home).

Let me know if you need help with any step—good luck with your AP exams!

rows.question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
rows.answer:
Here’s a summary of what Vista Ridge High School seniors (Class of 2027) need to do before graduation, based on the current information:

- **Order Cap & Gown:**  
  Order your Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit from Herff Jones. This is the only required item for graduation.

- **Attend Senior Meeting:**  
  Attend the senior meeting to receive order packets and information about graduation items.

- **Complete the FAFSA:**  
  Filling out the FAFSA is a graduation requirement. The application opens October 1st, and the priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15th.

- **Clear All Obligations and Hours:**  
  All obligations and hours must be cleared before you can pick up your cap and gown.

- **Participate in Senior Events:**  
  - Senior panoramic picture (March 24th during Ranger Time)
  - Prom (details to come)
  - Senior Scramble (details to come)
  - Senior Awards (invitation only)
  - Senior SAIL (relax and hang out in the VRHS courtyard)
  - Baccalaureate (morning celebration)
  - Graduation Practice and Clap Out
  - Elementary Graduation Walks (optional, for those who attended LISD elementary schools)

- **Graduation Cap Decorating:**  
  Follow the cap decorating guidelines—no inappropriate content, and suggested designs include thanking someone, recognizing post-secondary plans, or high school activities.

- **Name Pronunciation Form:**  
  Fill out the name pronunciation form (to be shared in May) to ensure your name is read correctly at graduation.

- **Google Account Transition:**  
  After graduation, your school Google account will switch to an alumni account (firstname.lastnameXX@alum.leanderisd.org). This account will be active for one year, but you won’t be able to create new documents. Download any files you want to keep to your personal computer.

- **Check University Deadlines:**  
  If you’re applying to college, check each university’s specific deadlines for applications and financial aid.

- **Project Graduation:**  
  Consider participating in Project Graduation for a safe, fun celebration after the ceremony.

For more details, you can visit the [Seniors 2027 page](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/seniors-2027) or reach out to the front office or your counselor if you have specific questions.

Let me know if you need more information about any of these steps—congratulations on your upcoming graduation!

rows.question: What is Ranger Time?
rows.answer:
Ranger Time at Vista Ridge High School is a dedicated period built into the daily schedule from 9:45 to 10:15 AM. It is also referred to as Minga-Flextime. During Ranger Time, students have the opportunity to participate in various activities, such as:

- Attending club meetings (for example, clubs like Rangers Alliance and Crafting for Kindness meet during Ranger Time)
- Engaging in personal growth workshops, volunteer drives, and networking activities
- Using the time for academic support, enrichment, or other school-related activities

Ranger Time is managed through the Minga platform, which you can access here: [Ranger Time (Minga-Flextime)](http://app.minga.io/flextime) or through the [Ranger Time Portal](https://adv.leanderisd.org/login.aspx?ReturnUrl=%2fDefault.aspx).

Let me know if you’d like more details about how to use Ranger Time or how to join a club during this period!

rows.question: How do I access my STAAR scores?
rows.answer:
You can access your STAAR scores in two main ways:

### 1. Through the Home Access Center (HAC)
- Log into your LISD Home Access Center ([Home Access Center](https://www.leanderisd.org/homeaccess)).
- Click on the Grades icon at the top of the screen.
- On the left, next to Report Card, click on Texas Test Scores.
- Your STAAR results will appear, or you’ll be directed to the Texas Student Portal.

### 2. Through the Texas Assessment Parent Portal
- Go to [texasassessment.gov](https://www.texasassessment.gov/).
- Click "Log In to Parent Portal."
- Enter your child’s Unique Access Code and date of birth.
    - If you don’t know the access code, click "How do I find my access code?" and enter your child’s legal first name and TSDS ID (or SSN) and date of birth.
- View and download your child’s full Confidential Student Report (CSR).

### Need Help?
If you have trouble accessing your scores or have questions, you can contact:
- Principal: Keith Morgan | keith.morgan@leanderisd.org
- Campus Testing Coordinator: Linsey Cernero | linsey.cernero@leanderisd.org

Let me know if you need the instructions in Spanish or have any other questions!
